lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Caelan, could you take these into the village for me? I promised to call on a few people, and I’m going to be needed here.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Yes. Who are we going to?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Halden first. Take the upper bridge to his cottage, just south of the mill. This is the medicine he asked for.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Are his hands troubling him again?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: They were when I saw him. He’s still trying to get everyone’s flour ready for tomorrow’s baking.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: We can help with the carrying while we’re there.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Please ask him. He may be more willing to let you help if he’s the one telling you where everything goes.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: He’ll tell us that anyway.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: *a small smile* Quite possibly.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: There’s bread and lamp oil for Elira, too. She’ll be getting her lantern ready for the Festival of Light.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: At home?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: She should be. Her cottage by the southern bridge. If she wants company, stay a little.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And these are for the Venns, up on the eastern terrace. Their little one’s still recovering.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Still not well enough to come outside?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I haven’t heard. Ask how this morning has been. They’ve hardly had a chance to think about anything beyond the next meal and the next bit of sleep.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Do they need anything else?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: They may. Let them tell you.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: Caelan, could you take these into the village for me? I promised to call on a few people, and I’m going to be needed here.

tomas.speaker: caelan
tomas.text: Yes. Who am I going to?

tomas.speaker: caelan

tomas.speaker: serene

tomas.speaker: serene

tomas.speaker: serene

tomas.speaker: serene

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: Ask how this morning has been. They’ve hardly had a chance to think about anything beyond the next meal and the next bit of sleep.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: They may. Let them tell you.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Hello, Caelan. How did you get on?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Everyone has their supplies. Halden asked whether someone could help with the carrying while he finishes the festival flour.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: He asked?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: He wanted me to make sure you knew that.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: *smiles* I’ll remember. Did the medicine reach him?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Yes. We moved the three sacks out of his doorway as well.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Good. I’ll speak to him about the rest.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Elira’s lantern is down on her table. She wants to bring it herself tomorrow.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I thought she might. Was she pleased to have it down?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Yes. She asked me to stay for a little while.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I’m glad you could.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: And the Venns said this morning’s been better. Their little one’s kept some food down.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Oh, that is good.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Their irrigation gate was jammed. I repaired it while I was there.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Is it working properly now?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: The water’s reaching the far end again. Mr. Venn said that was what he needed.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: *hesitates* I tried a spell on it first. I thought I could push the water back while I freed the pin.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: How did it go?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: It didn’t move. I ended up using the tools.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Do you want to tell me about it?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Later, perhaps.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Thank you for going round. I’ll follow up with them.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Is there anything else you need before I go?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Nothing that needs you now. Take the time you asked for this morning.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: I’ll go down to the brook, then.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Mira should be at her workbench outside the workshop, before the upper bridge. Tell her Halden’s waiting at the mill.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Thank you for looking in on everyone. I’ve still got Halden’s carrying to arrange.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Take the medicine across the upper bridge to Halden’s cottage, south of the mill. He may need help moving the festival flour.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Elira’s bread and lamp oil still need taking round. She should be at her cottage by the southern bridge.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: The Venns are up on the eastern terrace. Please take their supplies and ask how the little one’s been this morning.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Elira by the southern bridge, and the Venns on the eastern terrace. Either one next is fine.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And Caelan? Eat something before you go.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Half a slice of bread is not a meal.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Sit and eat. There'll be plenty to do before the festival.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: You said that yesterday.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And it was true yesterday.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: One more adjustment. Then I really am getting back to the preparations.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Should I tell Mother Serene that?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Tell her the preparations are progressing. That covers both things.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Caelan, can you look at this?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: It turns most of the way, then it sticks. I can't see what's catching.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Is the pin bent?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I thought so, but it looks straight.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Have you shown Mira?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Not yet. I wanted to get it working myself.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: You can still ask her.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I know. I will if I can't find it.

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Mind the sacks by the door. The mill doesn't give my knees a day off.

lines.speaker: elira
lines.text: Mind that stool. I keep telling myself I'll put it away.

lines.speaker: venn_mother
lines.text: It's been a quiet morning, thankfully.

lines.speaker: venn_father
lines.text: I ought to see to that channel before the afternoon.

lines.speaker: venn_child
lines.text: I had a whole bowl today.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Good. Rest a little longer.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Nearly there. This fitting has other ideas.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: Thank you for bringing us here, Caelan. I'll see you at the festival.

lines.speaker: regent_clerk
lines.text: I’m putting the inspection arrangements in order.

lines.speaker: regent_driver
lines.text: If you're looking at the brake, keep your fingers clear of the catch. It closes harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: lucan
lines.text: His lordship is expected at the festival. I’ll be staying with him.

note: Serene offers the opening quest through an explicit clicked choice and responds to its saved progress. Tomas retains his approved ambient conversation. Actual household task gameplay is implemented separately; entering a room never completes an errand.
